scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm -C server dev" "pnpm -C client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C server build && pnpm -C client build
scripts.lint: pnpm -C server lint && pnpm -C client lint
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm -C server install && pnpm -C client install
